messages.author: 27c035b57541552d
messages.subject: Parameter mapping from the template
parts:
In the documentation for MakeADFun it states:

More advanced parameter mapping, such as collecting parameters between different vectors etc., must be implemented from the template. 

Can you point me to an example of how to parameter map in the template?

Thanks

messages.author: 02e03030784aa6a7
messages.subject: Re: Parameter mapping from the template
parts:
I guess an example would be:

PARAMETER_VECTOR(mu)
PARAMETER_VECTOR(beta)

vector<Type> new_mu(mu.size())
new_mu(0) = mu(0)+beta(0);
new_mu(1) = mu(0)+mu(1)+beta(1);

From the R side you could fix components of mu and beta in different combinations.
